# Alcuin

> A CLI and stdio MCP server that sends a question and chosen source files to ChatGPT,
> or to the OpenAI or Azure OpenAI API, and saves each answer as a durable session.
> Windows and Linux only; model labels in ChatGPT do not prove which backend model answered.

Version 0.1.0 (unreleased). Needs Rust 1.99 or later; install from a checkout with
`cargo install --locked --path .`. Browser runs also need Google Chrome.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/EquityBot/Alcuin#readme): install, use, settings and known limitations.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/EquityBot/Alcuin/blob/main/SECURITY.md): what Alcuin can reach and how to report a vulnerability.
